en.answer: The activation and effect of <<12566>> cannot be negated, however the effect of <<11557>> prevents you from activating any Spell Cards, so <<12566>> cannot be activated.
en.question: While the effect of <<11557>> is applying, can I activate <<12566>> during my Main Phase 1?
